headline: Phireworx Media Day Experience
sub: A prepaid, creative-first media production shoot where the organization funds the session. Full digital access. Advanced lighting. A distinct visual identity built for your program.
core_heading: Not a Picture Day. A Production.
core_body: The Media Day Experience is a full creative shoot — smoke machines, colored gels, dramatic lighting, and intentional direction. Every athlete leaves with images that look like they belong in a press kit, not a school hallway.

what_you_get.title: Every Image Delivered
what_you_get.desc: Every edited photo from the shoot is yours. Complete usage rights. Use them however, whenever, for anything.

what_you_get.title: Advanced Production
what_you_get.desc: Smoke machines, colored gels, dramatic lighting setups — effects not feasible in high-volume picture day workflows.

what_you_get.title: Full Digital Ownership
what_you_get.desc: Every edited image from the shoot is delivered to you. Complete usage rights for recruiting, press, social media, and promotions.

what_you_get.title: Flexible Locations
what_you_get.desc: Gyms, fields, custom setups, or off-site environments. We build the look around your team's environment and identity.

ideal_programs.title: High School Varsity Programs
ideal_programs.desc: Give your varsity program the professional visual identity to match their level of competition.

ideal_programs.title: Club & Travel Teams
ideal_programs.desc: Stand out in recruiting, attract sponsors, and give your club team the professional look that elite organizations deserve.

ideal_programs.title: Athletic Departments
ideal_programs.desc: Cover multiple programs in a single day. Athletic directors use media shoots to refresh their entire department's visual assets for the season.

ideal_programs.title: Booster & Spirit Groups
ideal_programs.desc: Build booster materials, game programs, and spirit merch with professionally licensed photography.

ideal_programs.title: College Recruiting Prep
ideal_programs.desc: Athletes with professional-quality photos stand out in recruiting profiles.

ideal_programs.title: Youth Elite Programs
ideal_programs.desc: Top-tier youth programs deserve top-tier photos. Media shoots work for any roster size.

steps.title: Book & Pay Upfront
steps.desc: Submit a booking request. We confirm availability, review your program's needs, and invoice you. One flat rate, no surprises.

steps.title: Pre-Shoot Planning
steps.desc: We connect before the shoot to plan setup, location, roster size, and any custom looks or themes.

steps.title: Media Day
steps.desc: We handle everything on-site. Professional lighting, equipment, and direction. Athletes move through quickly.

steps.title: Editing & Delivery
steps.desc: All images professionally edited and delivered to your private download gallery within 7-10 business days.
